---
name: project-budgetbuddy-sept-2026-diagnosis
description: Sept 2026 diagnosis — income pre-fold drops money_movements (Rental −$2,948); Sept plan missing Compliance+Leasing ($141.67); fixes not yet applied
metadata:

Diagnosed 2026-09-02 (read-only, no fixes applied). Two separate defects, both born in the 12-14 Aug re-budget session:

1. **Income rollover drops prior-month money movements.** `foldIncomeCarry` (`src/envelope/service.ts:839-843`) folds `received − resolvedBudget` using `computeActivity` only; the expense pre-fold (line 639) adds `movementFor(...)` and visible-month income received includes movements. So Nick's 14 Aug move `Adhoc Income → Rental $2,948.00` (which zeroed August's rental deficit: carry $302 + $0 received − $3,250 expected) vanishes from September's fold — September Rental carry-in shows **−$2,948.00**, should be $0.00. Mirror image: Adhoc Income's September carry-in reads correspondingly high. Fix ISC: include money_movements in the income pre-range fold.

2. **Materialised months never pick up later-created envelopes.** `ensureMonth` no-ops when a month has allocation rows (`src/budget/service.ts:187-188`); only a version edit on an envelope rederives its materialised months. September was materialised before Compliance ($37.50/mo) and Leasing Fees ($104.17/mo) were created 12-13 Aug (annual lines, effective 2026-08-01, open-ended, never edited since), so September's plan lacks both rows → zero-base unallocated **$141.67** (income $13,213.00 − allocated $13,071.33). August was balanced to the cent. Cheapest data fix: any version edit on those two envelopes triggers rederive.
